purpose: Connect the paper's first-order and second-order loss approximations to the independent service validation at the locked adjacency horizon.
source_weights: Fixed OD-origin shares, identical to the exact feature
threshold_rule: Both approximations use the exact DPC training threshold. No surrogate-specific refitting and no selection using held-out outcomes.
stopping_rule: Accept the first successive quadrature pair passing the tolerance, then require all independent finite-difference checks. Failure at the largest pair blocks the held-out approximation comparison.
